title: WanJuan: A Comprehensive Multimodal Dataset for Advancing English and Chinese Large Models
findings: The paper introduces the WanJuan dataset and does not analyze, measure, or discuss any aspects of religion, faith, or religious bias. The data filtering process mentions removing 'bias' in general terms but does not provide specific examples or focus related to religion.
